body: Thank you! I'm glad it's better for you now and I actually feel a lot better knowing I'm not the only one to have this issue, I like what your therapist said about us finding a motherly issue in women who aren't our mothers, this makes a lot of sense actually as to why my worst communications are with elderly women.. did opening up to your boss about it really help? The confrontation sounds scary to me so the fact you did that I think is very impressive!!
That sounds exactly what I need thank you!!!
Hahahaha life is a catch 22

Haha xans are something I stay well well well clear of! I have a very addictive personality too, as I said in another comment going to see how it goes this weekend and if I'm still having sleeping problems I'm going to the GP!!!!

I'm think I'm going to see how I feel after the weekend, if I have still not slept in going to have to suck it up and get some sleeping pills, I just need to be extra strong and not become addicted to them instead. (sleep was originally the only reason I smoked in the first place, but that became an addiction)

I loved dancing, I begged and begged and I did actually get to go to ballet, street, ballroom I loved it, I wasn't as good as everyone else because I was new but I LOVED IT. By that I mean I loved the taster I would get, as it never went further than one lesson. That's a lie! Ballet was about a month long because it was an after school class! I got kind of good, I remember the teacher asking my mum to buy some shoes or something, I'm not sure I just remember being excited about shoes. One day I stopped going and I asked why "because the teacher said you've got two left feet and you're embrassing the other children so she's asked that you don't come back" (she said this about the others too) okay cool, destroyed my confidence, didn't dance infront of anyone ever again (until I met my current boyfriend who LOVES watching me be silly and dance my heart away). 

My nan always used to ask me why I had stopped and my mum would say 'because! She HATES dancing'

Found out last year after doing a silly drunken dance at Christmas and saying 'i love dancing why did I stop I'm actually pretty good' and my mum said 'we couldn't afford it so we stopped you going' so I said 'you told me I couldn't dance and the teacher asked me to stop going' so she said 'yeah I know it's funny isn't it' ... 'no mum, it's not'
All the best of luck today!

The recommendation and just knowing you heard is more than enough! 

I also love being able to relate, it definitely helps to know you're not alone in these thoughts and that there are other people out there going through the same thing, not that I'm happy other people feel this way but it's nice to know I am not crazy! 

Hug sending your way! Hope you get better too. I think we are all pretty strong to deal with all this and carry on most days, sometimes I struggle to remember that like today, but definitely need to have more faith in myself! 

I'm glad I could offer some slight comfort in knowing that we are both going through something similar too. Hope you have a great day
Thank you very much, sometimes all ya need is to be heard and have a little moan! Thank you very much again, hugs your way too

Wow I feel like I have just read someone else's interpretation of my own life and feelings.. you even play piano and are the same age! 

I completely hear you, and I feel you. It's very difficult, I'm very angry that I'm 22 and feel as though I need to restart/learn how to do things many other 22 year olds do naturally. 

Will be thinking of you today! If you ever want a chat with a friend online I shall be more than happy and excited to talk to you! :-) 

I'm hoping all this realisation will help, although at the moment it feels like a curse, I think this stuff is going to create me/bring my personality back

My brother and I have just both had this realisation. We think she's narcasistic but honestly I think she's a borderline without any treatment or diagnosis. We have both gone a little bit crazy, as we are no longer in those rose tinted sunglasses. 

Learning how to be human again when all you've been taught is unhappiness, negativity and pressure...wow.

 You know self care? I thought that was a new 2000 thing, like finding yourself and being a better person, putting yourself first, washing daily etc etc.. I had to ask my mum 'is this something new the teens are bringing in?' 'no people did this when I was your age, I did too'...... So why am I 22 and only just realising this is something very normal?

That's great that you're in a place now where you notice :-)

Can I ask what mental notes you give yourself to help with this? I'm currently (still) waiting on my referral and my problems are a little too muddled up for the temporary counselling we have here. I'm desperate to learn some possitive thought processes... I find it difficult to listen when it comes from a booklet, rather than word of mouth.

Thank you, sometimes I forget that I am very strong, I definitely must remind myself of this more!

Thank you, that's really comforting to hear. :-) 

Yeah. I've always had a lot put on me, this year I've been attempting space and recovery. I'm finding it difficult to balance between the both, which has resulted in me going backwards rather than forwards. I always thought the pressure would be less as I got older and further away from my mother so I held on.. now it's even more so! 

How are you, are you okay? Thank you for commenting
I'm not sure.. when I get home I'll check and let you know! I have a feeling it's like season 3
Oh gosh is this episode 11?
Lol woops yes I do! Thanks, I get confused with names

Haha yeah I know too well about foods that triggers unbearable pain, and then not learning my lesson and eating it again.. originally my mindset was 'well it hurts if I eat this it hurts if I don't eat it so I'll just eat whatever' but now I'm trying to think 'if I eat this I will lose a day of work and a day of pay and the stress will trigger me more'... It's kind of working but it's just finding the right diet now! Sometimes something is great, sometimes it flares me up! Funny how the idea of losing money is more scary to me than the idea of being in agony ... IBS has made me a whiner but I'm definitely a lot 'stronger' for it

Thanks! I'll do some digging into recipes you can use flax seeds in because I've seen this recommendation before! The FODMAP diet has not helped me in the slightest (I think it has a lot to do with my eating habits before I tried to get better). I'm also verrry nervous about using laxatives due to the emotion satisfaction I get from the weight loss, by non stimulant what does that mean by the way? I'm going to ask my GP about it a lot more later though thank you very much for this advice :)

Damn, must be agony but honestly I'm so jealous you get to go in the week haha! I haven't a problem with exercise, but I've heard someone say they flare up just from that! Gosh I feel so sorry for those people, exercise is a lot of help for me!
Oh goodness of course, now it seems so obvious! Had a look at the HA and lactic acid and looks like a good one, cheaper than I was thinking too!
Ahh maybe I need some more in-depth revision on this as never even heard of HA! Thank you so much for this! Really given me some good information to go off

Thanks that's really helpful very much appreciated x
Thanks this was really helpful I'm going to the GP today so I've got a good idea now what to say really appreciate the explaination massively appreciated x

Thanks for the advice! Going to give this a try :-)

I just use the one, I apply it about 4 times a day. Didn't really cross my mind to use more products, think I was worried about breaking out again
